image_description: A close-up, angled view of a vintage audio cassette tape. The casing is primarily white/translucent plastic with a red and black paper label wrapped around the spine and face. The label features text including 'MAGNETIC TAPE' and '120'. Two circular windows reveal the internal spools; one spool appears to have blue/purple tape or a blue hub, while the other is obscured or empty. The top edge shows the write-protect tab area. The image has a slightly grainy, retro aesthetic.
